Amtech Systems.why: its Thermal Processing Solutions segment sells thermal processing equipment for AI advanced packaging and AI server board assembly; AI-related segment revenue grew about 120% YoY
Amtech Systems.evidence: Amtech Systems Q3 FY2026 call (08-05-2026), CEO Bob Daigle: 'Demand for our advanced packaging equipment and AI server board assembly solutions remains exceptionally strong'; 'AI-related revenue for our Thermal Processing Solutions segment was very strong, up by approximately 120%'

players.product: thermal processing equipment for AI advanced packaging and AI server board assembly (Thermal Processing Solutions segment)

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026): revenue $22.4 million, up 14% YoY and at the top end of guidance. Thermal Processing Solutions (TPS) revenue approximately $17.7 million, up nearly 25% YoY; AI-related TPS revenue up approximately 120% YoY and more than 40% of TPS revenue; TPS parts and services up approximately 30%, 20% of TPS revenue. Semiconductor Fabrication Solutions (SFS) revenue $4.6 million, down just over 13%. Gross margin 50% (46.7% a year ago); adjusted EBITDA $3.3 million, approaching 15% of sales; GAAP net income approximately $1.7 million ($0.10 per diluted share); no debt.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $22.4 million (+14% YoY); AI-related TPS revenue up approximately 120%; gross margin 50%

quarterly_data.signal: Orders: TPS book-to-bill approached 1.4 in the quarter, driven by AI-related equipment demand - the third consecutive quarter above one; company-wide bookings exceeded sales for the third consecutive quarter. Despite short lead times, bookings scheduled for shipment in future quarters increased significantly; CEO expects the TPS backlog to convert primarily in fiscal Q1 2027 and partly in Q2 2027. Inventory rose $1.7 million since the start of the fiscal year to support the backlog.

Outlook for fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ending September 30, 2026; CFO Tom Sabol): revenue of $22.5 million-$24 million and adjusted EBITDA margins in the low to mid-teens; AI-related equipment for the TPS segment is expected to drive the majority of revenue growth and account for well over 40% of segment sales. R&D spending may increase in coming quarters as Amtech builds out platforms for next-generation opportunities.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 FY2026 revenue $22.5 million-$24 million; adjusted EBITDA margin low to mid-teens

quarterly_data.signal: New products: to accelerate growth beyond 2027, Amtech is developing new equipment platforms and process capabilities for emerging semiconductor applications and higher-density packaging, and plans to introduce some of them at the SEMICON Taiwan trade show in early September; CEO expects lead times initially at or slightly above its typical six to eight weeks.

AI packaging demand (CEO Bob Daigle): 'Demand for our advanced packaging equipment and AI server board assembly solutions remains exceptionally strong' due to its true-flat technology and temperature uniformity. Amtech ships to OSATs and major OEMs; its equipment is agnostic to which hyperscaler it serves and is used across GPU and TPU applications - 'We're tied really to overall demand in these infrastructure build-outs, not necessarily specific to any one player or customer.'

First order for equipment used to produce cooling components for AI semiconductors (direct removal of heat from the chips), extending Amtech beyond advanced packaging and server board assembly; the customer is building its process around Amtech's equipment, similar to the heat-exchanger equipment it sold for EV batteries. CEO: 'It's too early to tell' how big the opportunity is.

SFS segment (CEO): the revenue decline was driven by a significant drop in demand for P.R. Hoffman templates used in silicon carbide substrate manufacturing; due to structural changes in the silicon carbide industry Amtech does not expect a meaningful recovery and has de-emphasized it. Entrepix parts and service revenue grew 19% YoY. Amtech would consider synergistic acquisitions that expand its capability in AI.
quarterly_data.figure: Entrepix parts and service revenue +19% YoY
